verdict.rationale: Fin can be driven without its UI. The Fin Agent API lets you call Fin from your own systems, though the orchestration endpoints are Preview-only. There is also an official TypeScript SDK and a Fin CLI that coding agents can use to set up and configure Fin from a dev environment. However, nothing documents running Fin non-interactively in CI pipelines, and scenario testing is presented as a no-engineer UI workflow. Missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration (e.g., automated test runs or config-as-code in CI), non-interactive CLI auth and usage details, GA status for the orchestration API, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
